== Notes ==
* This skill cannot "steal" [[Monster skill|monster]]-only hex spells (e.g. [[Crystal Bonds]]); however, the energy gain does happen and Revealed Hex recharges instantly.
* This skill is not susceptible to recharge-lengthening skills like [[Diversion]].
* If the caster is in the process of casting the copied hex spell at the end of the 20 seconds copy duration, the casting of the spell will [[fail]].
